    Compiling Figure-14 coefficients into a Hom-bifunctor retraction #

    The literal Figure-14 source is realized on four ambient objects by repeating the two central objects at the left and right leaves:

    X --delta--> Y --lambda--> X --delta--> Y,

    with the remaining arrows Y --first--> L and U --last--> X. Coherent central and arm coefficients, together with the explicit off-path vanishing conditions, give a coefficient for every ordered pair of source vertices. The generator tables below compile these coefficients into the thin-path retraction used by the cleaving argument.

      The scalar coefficient attached to each ordered pair of Figure-14 vertices. Its nonzero entries are exactly the identities, the five arrows, the four length-two paths, and the central length-three path.
